test_runtime: CPython 3.13 offline container; production image is CPython 3.12
upgrade_policy: operator-upgrade-v1 (receipt v7): GET-only reconciliation, ledger unchanged, execution stays stopped
ai_incomplete_output_fix: recorded request ladder: reasoning_effort=low/12000 -> thinking disabled/4000 -> plain/16000
end_policy: adaptive exit capacity, no fixed hour entry cutoff
coverage_policy: hours without trades carried at last trade price with zero volume; latest hour must trade; <=12/49 and <=18/72 empty hours
take_profit_policy: TP1 = strategy take-profit (structural target, 2.5R for trend strategies or 48h swing high), at least max(1R, 2x round-trip cost) above basis; d = TP1-basis, TP2 = TP1+d, TP3 = TP1+2d; whole position held, no partial sells; stop to break-even+0.4% after +1R or TP1, to TP1 at TP2; full exit at TP3; a 4.3.0 ladder on an open position is rebuilt without lowering its stop
quality_policy: min quality 55/100 before AI; AI min confidence 0.65
fast_layer_policy: 15-minute closed buckets from public 1-minute candles: entry needs EMA8>EMA21 and close>EMA8; exit on close below 2h swing low with EMA8<EMA21 after 30 minutes; TRX trend hold respected
shadow_test: all screened candidates followed on public 5-minute candles without orders; AI-approved vs AI-skipped comparison
wallet_observation_policy: balances-detail TMN accepted only as the nearest integer of the exact ledger (observed rounding down and up); spending uses the lower of reported and ledger cash; the operator upgrade clears wallet_ledger_mismatch only after a fresh GET-only recheck passes
decision_page_history: scans recorded before 4.3.0 get per-pair stages by replaying the screener on the immutable hourly observations, used only when counts equal the recorded coverage; otherwise recorded coverage counts
llm_provider_policy: OpenAI-compatible providers avalai/metisai/boxapi with pinned hosts; provider, model, base URL and bound keys change only through the v7 operator upgrade; replacement keys for bound credentials are staged and promoted in the rebinding transaction
strategy_studio: agentic LLM loop (propose/backtest/tune/save) over a validated JSON strategy specification; backtests on recorded hourly data in memory without orders or AI; human full test and approval required; approved specifications enter the engine config via the operator upgrade and pass the same quality, AI, sizing and exit controls
exit_order_policy: all algorithmic sells (stops, take-profit, time/trend exits, portfolio halt, final TMN conversion) use a marketable LIMIT 5% below the best bid (exit_limit_bps=500): immediate fills against visible bids with a bounded worst price; no historical-volume throttle on exits, visible bid depth and order cap bind; native TRX stop uses a 5% deep limit (stop-market behaviour) and an operator replacement path cancels the resting stop before a renewed approval; raw MARKET/STOP_MARKET avoided because their reply contract is undocumented
shadow_candles: Wallex public UDF has no 5-minute resolution: 5/15-minute bars are aggregated from 1-minute candles (shadow test, market and equity charts)
dust_policy: a holding below the market minimum quantity or minimum notional cannot be sold on Wallex; it no longer occupies a regime position slot (controller capacity and planner entry check)
minimum_order_policy: no order below 50,000 TMN (min_order_tmn); entries need at least 60,000 TMN (min_entry_tmn) so a position stays sellable after its full stop; a chunked exit never leaves a remainder below the minimum plus 10%
